description: Turn a size in one system into every other system: rings, shoes, clothing, suits, belts and hats, or one designer's own chart (pass designer as its slug, e.g. 'nike'). Answers only from the size tables on shopwithin.co/sizes, where every row comes from a named source with the day it was read, and returns the page that shows the answer. Use this when a shopper asks what their size is in another country's system, which size to take in a designer, or how a designer's sizes run. Call it without from and size to list the systems and tables a kind or a designer has.

department.description: Optional: only women's or men's tables.

designer.description: A designer's slug, as in shopwithin.co/designers/<slug>, to read that designer's own charts instead of a kind.

from.description: The system the size is written in, as a key this tool lists, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'eu'.

kind.description: What is being sized: rings, shoes, clothing, suits, belts or hats.

table.description: Optional: one table or chart id this tool lists.

to.description: Optional: one system key to lead the answer with.

name: convert_size
title: Convert a size
